I can’t inspect Docker from this session because no terminal execution tool is available. Run:

```powershell
docker ps --filter "name=checkout" --format "table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}"
docker inspect --format "{{json .State.Health}}" checkout
```

A passing check reports `"Status":"healthy"`. If it is unhealthy, inspect recent probe output with:

```powershell
docker inspect --format "{{range .State.Health.Log}}{{.End}} Exit={{.ExitCode}} {{printf `%s` .Output}}{{println}}{{end}}" checkout
docker logs --tail 100 checkout
```
